briefings.title: Jesper Brodin – Former CEO of Ingka Group (IKEA) | Investment Conference 2026
briefings.tldr: By leveraging its deeply rooted corporate culture and choosing optimism, IKEA successfully navigated the pandemic—scaling its digital operations in weeks rather than years—and decoupled economic growth (+24% revenue) from carbon emissions (-30% absolute carbon reduction) through cost-saving, climate-smart innovations.
